cases.description: When a newly constructed Message has never had a TSIG set, getGeneratedTSIG() should return null.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord instance with the same key name, algorithm, and MAC as the TSIG key provided to setTSIG(TSIG)
cases.description: After calling setTSIG(TSIG key) on the Message, getGeneratedTSIG() must return the TSIGRecord that was generated by the setTSIG call. The returned record should contain the TSIG key information supplied.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord instance whose error field equals the error code passed to setTSIG(TSIG, int, TSIGRecord)
cases.description: When setTSIG(TSIG key, int error, TSIGRecord querytsig) is invoked, the Message creates a TSIGRecord reflecting the supplied error code. getGeneratedTSIG() should return that TSIGRecord, allowing verification of the error field.
If setTSIG is called with a null TSIG key, the implementation should leave generatedTsig as null; consequently getGeneratedTSIG() returns null.

group: Message.getGeneratedTSIG() after setTSIG with error and null querytsig

cases.expected: TSIGRecord whose error field equals the supplied error code and whose MAC field is null (because querytsig was null)
cases.description: Call setTSIG(TSIG key, int errorCode, null) on a Message. The generated TSIG record should store the provided error code while leaving the MAC undefined. getGeneratedTSIG() must return this record.

group: Message.getGeneratedTSIG() after setTSIG with error and non‑null querytsig

cases.expected: TSIGRecord whose error field equals the supplied error code and whose MAC field equals the MAC of the provided querytsig
cases.description: Create a TSIG key and a TSIGRecord queryTsig with a known MAC (e.g., byte[] {0x01,0x02}). Call setTSIG(key, errorCode, queryTsig). The generated TSIG must copy the MAC from queryTsig and the error code. getGeneratedTSIG() should return this record.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord reflecting the parameters of the *last* setTSIG invocation (previous generatedTsig is overwritten)
cases.description: Invoke setTSIG(keyA) then setTSIG(keyB, error=5, null). The Message should keep only the TSIG generated by the second call. getGeneratedTSIG() must return a record that matches keyB and error=5, not the first one.
After the two calls above, invoke setTSIG(null). The generated TSIG should be cleared. getGeneratedTSIG() must return null.

group: Message.getGeneratedTSIG() after cloning a signed Message

cases.expected: TSIGRecord equal in content to the original Message's generatedTsig (key name, algorithm, MAC, error)
cases.description: Create a Message, call setTSIG(key, error=0, null) to generate a TSIG, then clone the Message via Message.clone(). The clone should retain the generated TSIG. getGeneratedTSIG() on the clone must return a TSIGRecord whose fields match those of the original.

group: Message.getGeneratedTSIG() after clearing TSIG following a successful setTSIG

cases.description: Call setTSIG(key) to create a generated TSIG, then call setTSIG(null) to clear it. getGeneratedTSIG() should return null, confirming that the clear operation overwrites the previous generatedTsig.
